description: Paint (or sculpt) a grass tile in the lot's exterior terrain at (x,y,level). `pattern` selects grass density/type. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side; server-side BuildBuyRoommate+). Effect: grass tile pattern updates at that tile — observable via query-architecture (floor.pattern on exterior tiles). Cost: minimal. Denial silent (OQ-8). Wire: VMNetArchitectureCmd { Commands: [{ Type: GRASS_DOT, level, x, y, pattern }] }.
